stories.title: Inside the Biggest Feud in Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: There's a major disagreement happening between important people in the artificial intelligence industry.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — it won't affect your daily life or business operations right now.

stories.title: Top AI leaders to meet with Trump at White House amid dire warnings about technology
stories.simple_summary: Leaders of big AI companies are going to meet with the President at the White House to talk about their concerns about AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in the tech industry — what government decides about AI rules could eventually affect small businesses, but nothing is happening yet.

stories.title: Slovenia sees surge in '.si' sites after Trump hypes 'super intelligence'
stories.simple_summary: People are buying websites ending in '.si' (which is for Slovenia) thinking they can use 'si' as shorthand for 'super intelligence,' after someone mentioned 'super intelligence' in the news.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a funny internet quirk with no real impact on you or your business.

stories.title: As A.I. Panic Grows, Javier Milei Is Pitching Argentina As a Rules-Free Haven
stories.simple_summary: Argentina's leader is trying to attract AI companies by saying the country will have fewer rules and regulations for them.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about international business and politics — nothing you need to worry about unless you're involved in very large tech investments.

stories.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
stories.simple_summary: An AI company called Anthropic is losing enormous amounts of money each year but is also growing very fast. They also warned investors that their AI technology itself could theoretically pose risks to humanity.
stories.why_it_matters: The money-losing part is normal for young tech companies trying to grow — this mostly matters to investors. The warning about AI risks is honest, but doesn't mean anything bad is happening right now.

stories.title: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI decided not to release a new AI model because they had safety concerns about how it worked.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI companies are taking safety seriously before releasing products to the public, which is a good sign.

stories.title: Contradicting Trump, Pope Leo says artificial intelligence safety concerns not ‘fake news’
stories.simple_summary: The Pope said that worries about AI safety are legitimate concerns, not fake or made-up news.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a statement about the conversation people are having — it doesn't change anything practical for your business or life.

stories.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
stories.simple_summary: An investment company is funding a group of 18 new AI startups (mostly in India) with money to help them grow.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people starting tech companies — nothing that affects ordinary small-business owners.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI canceled releasing an AI model because it wasn't following instructions the way it should.
stories.why_it_matters: Like the earlier OpenAI story, this shows responsible AI companies testing their products carefully before releasing them.

stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.simple_summary: A large computer chip company (AMD) is buying a smaller AI research company (World Labs) for about $8.2 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about large corporate investments and industry changes — nothing you need to act on as a small-business owner.

stories.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
stories.simple_summary: An AI infrastructure company (Modal Labs) is raising new investment money at a value three times higher than it was four months ago.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors and tech people — the startup world moves fast, but this doesn't affect everyday businesses.

stories.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
stories.simple_summary: AMD is purchasing an AI company called World Labs for $8.2 billion, and the company's founder will become a top scientist at AMD.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about corporate deals and industry reshuffling — nothing you need to worry about as a regular business owner.
